basic_info.description: $55K PRICE REDUCTION!! Discover a hidden treasure in San Francisco's Lone Mountain! This fully detached single-family home at 63 Paramount Terrace offers a perfect blend of tranquility and modern living. Nestled on a serene cul-de-sac, this recently remodeled gem boasts a brand new kitchen with quartz counters, sleek cabinets, and stainless steel appliances. It features three spacious bedrooms plus a versatile office / nursery along with three fully remodeled bathrooms. The inviting living room and dining area feature a cozy fireplace. Outside, enjoy a quiet backyard space with an extra-large deck. The oversized garage provides ample storage throughout and houses the washer and dryer units. Enjoy the vibrant Lone Mountain community, home to the University of San Francisco, with nearby amenities such as Rossi Park, offering a pool, tennis courts, basketball, and playground, and the Koret Center with fitness facilities and a pool. The location provides easy access to Golden Gate Park and The Presidio, along with a diverse array of dining options and retail experiences. Built circa 1940, Paramount Terrace showcases a collection of charming single-family homes. Experience the best of San Francisco living!
